annotations.title: Edit a scheduled post (caption, first comments, platforms)

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] CHANGES WHAT A SCHEDULED POST WILL PUBLISH on real accounts, keeping its slot, accounts, options, labels and draft. `firstComment` sets per-platform first comments (linkedin, facebook, instagram, threads, youtube; null removes; X/Bluesky have none); `text` / `platformText` change the caption; `applyAutoFirstComment: true` adds the brand's auto first comment where none is set; `removePlatforms` drops platforms from this booking (e.g. a duplicate TikTok); `labels` replaces the post's own labels (e.g. ["repost:evergreen"]; alone it never touches the booking, status "labeled"). More optional arguments, not listed: instanceLabels. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"update_scheduled_post"}.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

firstComment.description: Format: object; e.g. {"linkedin":"Example"}. Fields: linkedin, facebook, instagram, threads, youtube.

text.description: Format: string; e.g. "Discover our new collection.".
